source_text.body:
Map top autonomous agents into a comparison sheet and deck
A reviewer had Manus map the top 10 autonomous AI agents, build a comparison spreadsheet with pricing, GAIA scores and compliance posture, and output a slide deck in about 40 minutes. The reviewer disagreed with two rankings.
·
Aug 2, 2026
Done with
MA
Manus
What they did
The reviewer gave Manus one brief: map the top 10 autonomous AI agents as of April 2026, build a comparison spreadsheet covering pricing, GAIA scores and compliance posture, and produce a slide deck. Manus ran it in its sandboxed environment with no further steps described, and returned the sheet and a 12-slide deck.
How it went
It finished in roughly 40 minutes and used about 3,800 credits. The sheet was accurate for 8 of 10 tools, and two pricing rows were a version out of date. The disagreement over two rankings in the summary comes from a separate resume-ranking test.
Worth knowing
Check the pricing rows by hand, since they were the stale part. A run like this cost about 3,800 credits, close to the whole 4,000 monthly allowance on the $20 plan.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
Research the top [number] [product category, e.g. autonomous AI agents] and build a comparison spreadsheet covering [columns, e.g. pricing, benchmark scores, compliance, key strengths], citing a source for each figure. Then turn the findings into a slide deck of about [number] slides with a clear ranking and the reasoning behind it. Flag any places where the data was thin or uncertain so I can check them.
Original source: https://theplanettools.ai/tools/manus
